Subject: Neo Launch cohort voucher ask — cohort starts Jan 10

Hi Karthik,

We run the Neo Launch accelerator (next cohort starts Jan 10). We have ~18 portfolio startups that will run early-stage product experiments and were evaluating vendor credits for compute. Historically we partner with vendors who offer a cohort voucher + ability to extend trials for select teams.

Can Redwood provide a cohort voucher (one-time) and a 30-day trial extension for startups that accept the voucher? Rough ask: $8k total credit pool plus extended trial for up to 6 companies. Were open to a conditional plan tied to onboarding milestones.

Attached is a csv roster with company names and a brief use-case column. We can also return a signed MSA if that helps expedite.

A few quick Qs for your team:
- What documentation do you need to qualify an accelerator voucher?
- Any SLA or billing hold restrictions for promotional credits?
- Can credits be applied to dedicated capacity later if a company converts?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if thats easier.

Best,
Alina Gomez
Partnerships Lead, Neo Accelerator
Alina@neoaccelerator.com

Attachments: neo_program_roster.csv (csv, 12KB)

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Neo Launch cohort voucher ask — cohort starts Jan 10

Hi Alina — thanks for the note and the roster. This is the right sort of ask for our Launch/Founders program and wed like to support the cohort.

Quick answers up front:
- Qualification: we need a signed MSA (or an e-signed commitment page) and a short list of the specific companies that will claim the voucher. For the extender (30-day trial) we also ask for a short onboarding plan per company so our customer success team can prioritize.
- SLA/billing holds: promotional credits are applied to hosted usage only by default; dedicated capacity conversion is possible but requires a separate purchase order and approval.
- Billing: credits expire 90 days after activation unless otherwise approved in writing.

Im looping in Laura (partnership ops) and Marcus (program credits) to confirm internal approval path. Can you send the MSA and SOC2 snapshot (if available)? With those we can do a one-time voucher allocation.

Proposed next steps:
1) Neo sends signed MSA + SOC2 snapshot (if available)
2) Redwood reviews and sends allocation terms + DocuSign link
3) Active voucher portal + activation instructions to cohort companies

Im happy to approve a provisional $10k allocation but final amount will be reconciled after review — Laura/Marcus, any concerns?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
